description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget `HomeFragment` which presents a Google Map interface with location and ride features. It manages user location, markers, routing, ride simulation, and UI overlays for location info and ride status, mimicking the behavior of the original Kotlin code for a ride-sharing app's home fragment.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a full-screen Google Map with location pins, routes, and ride control UI overlays, managing state for user location, markers, routing, and ride simulation.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: The state class for HomeFragment, handling map initialization, user location fetch, marker management, route drawing, ride simulation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches user's current GPS location, reverse geocodes to address, initializes map camera and markers.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude into a human-readable address string.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Creates initial rider markers near user's location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Builds the Google Map widget, with error fallback UI.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays placeholder UI if Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles map camera movement end; triggers reverse geocoding for new center.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Builds the bottom overlay with location info, destination, and ride controls.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Shows a card with current ride status message.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens location search bottom sheet for destination input.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles destination selection: geocoding address, adding markers, drawing route, zooming map.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a curved polyline between origin and destination points.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Generates intermediate points to create a curved route line.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Fits map view to include both user location and destination.

methods.name: _showRideBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays ride booking options as a bottom sheet.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching the user by updating markers periodically.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Triggers when rider arrives; prompts starting journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates journey towards destination with marker updates.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Finalizes ride, resets states, and navigates to celebration screen.
